name: claude-team-chat
description: Chat with other Claude Code users in rooms joined by a 4-character code: a chat pane, /chat, and tools Claude can use to read and send messages.

server.title: Relay server URL
server.description: The claude-team-chat relay everyone in the room connects to, e.g. https://chat.example.com or http://192.168.1.20:47800

name.title: Display name
name.description: The name others see. Empty uses your login name. /chat name <new name> changes it any time.

room.title: Room code to start in
room.description: A 4-character room code (A-Z, a-z, 0-9; capitals matter) to join at start. Empty: none until /chat new or /chat join <code>.

token.title: Relay token
token.description: The CHAT_TOKEN set on the relay, needed to make rooms with /chat new. Empty when the relay has none.
